architecture.mechanism: Vibration promotes freezing of the aluminum-adjuvanted vaccine.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a lightweight vibration-damping suspension (e.g., elastomeric mounts) into the cold-chain container to isolate vaccine vials from motorbike vibration.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduces vibration-induced freezing events, preventing freeze damage to the vaccine during last-mile transport.
architecture.falsification_test: Compare the proportion of vials showing freeze damage (aluminum-salt particle size increase) between containers with and without vibration damping after simulated motorbike transport at -5°C for 48 hours.
